controls.title: The information system SHALL enforce approved authorizations for controlling access to the system.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system SHALL enforce approved authorizations for controlling access to the system. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) SHALL be implemented for all cloud resources, and least privilege SHALL be enforced by default.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
The information system SHALL enforce approved authorizations for controlling access to the system. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) SHALL be implemented for all cloud resources, and least privilege SHALL be enforced by default.
Production workloads SHALL be isolated from development and testing environments using network segmentation, security groups, or virtual private cloud (VPC) boundaries.
Cross-environment access SHALL require explicit approval from the environment owner.

controls.title: Successful and unsuccessful logon attempts

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Successful and unsuccessful logon attempts

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
The Organization SHALL determine that the information system is capable of auditing the following events:
Successful and unsuccessful logon attempts
Account creation and modification
Privilege escalation
Resource provisioning and deprovisioning
Security group changes
Data export operations
Each auditable event SHALL include the timestamp, source IP address, user or service account identity, action performed, and outcome (success or failure).

controls.title: The Organization SHALL configure the information system to provide only essential capabilities.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Organization SHALL configure the information system to provide only essential capabilities.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
The Organization SHALL configure the information system to provide only essential capabilities.
Unnecessary services, daemons, protocols, and ports SHALL be disabled.
Default credentials SHALL be changed before any system goes into production.
Only software approved by the Organization's software catalog SHALL be installed on production systems.

controls.title: The information system SHALL monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key intern...

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The information system SHALL monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
The information system SHALL monitor and control communications at the external boundary of the system and at key internal boundaries.
A default-deny firewall policy SHALL be enforced, with only explicitly approved traffic permitted.
All communications crossing trust boundaries SHALL be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Internal service-to-service communications within the production environment SHALL use mutual TLS (mTLS) where technically feasible.

controls.title: The Organization SHALL identify, report, and correct information system flaws.

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: The Organization SHALL identify, report, and correct information system flaws.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose:
The Organization SHALL identify, report, and correct information system flaws.
Critical and high severity vulnerabilities SHALL be remediated within 15 business days of discovery.
Medium severity vulnerabilities SHALL be remediated within 30 business days.
Security patches SHALL be applied to all production systems within 14 days of release.
Emergency patches for actively exploited vulnerabilities SHALL be applied within 48 hours.
